edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a protective direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: The Epley maneuver mechanically repositions displaced otoconia out of the semicircular canal, directly addressing the cause of BPPV.
edges.summary: The anchor for this edge is the 2023 Saishoji meta analysis in BMC Prim Care, which suggests that epley manoeuvre tracks with lower risk or better outcomes for benign paroxysmal positional vertigo. Later papers point in much the same direction, so the live uncertainty is usually about effect size or which subgroups carry the signal most strongly.
edges.caveats: Healthier-user bias, screening intensity, and baseline risk can all inflate apparent benefit in observational work, so the magnitude should be read conservatively.
